analysis: Source pass over base text of ClusterOnboardingLive.swift lines 894-1622 (receiveFromPeer, downloadOnThisMac, adopt/localAdopt, localRegister, command, serve/setScope, readiness, status, stop paths). The PR's changed ranges (base 1039, 1044, 1048, 1073; head 1048-1059, 1084) thread a ClusterServingScope through planModels/adopt: planModels now sends scope from context.settings.servingScope in the forwarded ClusterControlRequest, the remote handler passes request.scope into localPlanModels/localAdopt, and a new planningScope() resolves named ?? settings ?? leadership.scope ?? .publicServing. Scope only affects planning (tensor-assistant discovery mode) per the doc comment; serving scope persistence remains in localSetScope (base 1192-1216) and localServe. Forwarded requests arrive over the paired Thunderbolt link (ClusterSetupLinkExchange with pairing), so a peer-supplied scope is from the already-trusted paired member; it influences only which plan is chosen, not coordinator registration (localRegister still gated by ClusterApprovalSync with installed facts) nor local API network exposure (ready() at base 1385-1391 still requires the part's own local-only notice). Defaulting to .publicServing when nothing is saved matches prior behavior (offeredLine base 1438 uses the same default). No mapping to provider threats (TB-002/TB-011/T-053) or prefix-cache T-041 changed. Integration questions: verify head localPlanModels(scope:)/localAdopt(scope:) do not persist the forwarded scope into leadership.scope or change localOnly/network reachability (head lines ~606-633, 1048-1084 not visible here); confirm the cluster link command channel authenticates the peer. No regression identified from visible evidence.
